sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Explore red node adjacency and path
nodes = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
by_id = {n['id']:n for n in nodes}
adj = current_frame.segmentation['adjacency_list']
maze_nodes = {n['id']:n for n in nodes if n['color'] in ('W','g')}
red_ids = {n['id'] for n in nodes if n['color']=='R'}
blue = [n for n in nodes if n['color']=='b'][0]
green = [n for n in nodes if n['color']=='N'][0]
# Build graph including red as traversable
from collections import defaultdict, deque
g = defaultdict(set)
for i,j in adj:
    if i in maze_nodes or i in red_ids:
        if j in maze_nodes or j in red_ids:
            g[i].add(j); g[j].add(i)
# adjacency
adjacent_maze = []
for i,j in adj:
    if i==blue['id'] and (j in maze_nodes or j in red_ids):
        adjacent_maze.append(j)
    if j==blue['id'] and (i in maze_nodes or i in red_ids):
        adjacent_maze.append(i)
green_adj = []
for i,j in adj:
    if i==green['id'] and (j in maze_nodes or j in red_ids):
        green_adj.append(j)
    if j==green['id'] and (i in maze_nodes or i in red_ids):
        green_adj.append(i)
print('blue adj', adjacent_maze)
print('green adj', green_adj)

def bfs(starts, goals):
    q=deque(); parent={}; seen=set()
    for s in starts:
        q.append(s); seen.add(s); parent[s]=None
    while q:
        cur=q.popleft()
        if cur in goals:
            path=[cur]
            while parent[path[-1]] is not None:
                path.append(parent[path[-1]])
            path.reverse()
            return path
        for nb in g.get(cur, []):
            if nb not in seen:
                seen.add(nb); parent[nb]=cur; q.append(nb)
    return None

path = bfs(adjacent_maze, green_adj)
def centroid(node):
    rows=[p[0] for p in node['boundary']]
    cols=[p[1] for p in node['boundary']]
    return sum(rows)/len(rows), sum(cols)/len(cols)
cents={nid:centroid(by_id[nid]) for nid in path}
moves=[]
for a,b in zip(path, path[1:]):
    ra,ca=cents[a]; rb,cb=cents[b]
    dr=rb-ra; dc=cb-ca
    if abs(dr)>abs(dc):
        moves.append('DOWN' if dr>0 else 'UP')
    else:
        moves.append('RIGHT' if dc>0 else 'LEFT')
print('path nodes', path)
print('moves', moves)
if moves:
    action(moves)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
